script.source: Detection_Test rolls 0–99 plus current Detect. Detection_DirectObject tests ordinary Disguise or Invisibility, compares strictly to 50 + 8×duration + 4×rank, and removes ordinary or imparted invisibility on success. NPC Detection 627 and NPC admin disguise have different callbacks.
script.runtime: ConcealmentDetection uses one roll for qualifying caster-area opponents, ends the matching stealth generation and sends the counter effect.
script.test: PR720 and its stock-frame replay verify the Countermeasure, 5 IS, 10 s reuse, counter FX, both hostile invisibility forms, ally exclusion and retained Shadow. PR668 confirms ordinary Disguise restoration and PR686 confirms the facing-independent 12 m boundary. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/720#issuecomment-7072619758 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/668#issuecomment-7064793307 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/686#issuecomment-7067494677
